text:
WITH EFFECT FROM 01 JAN 27 THE UK GOLF SERIES NOTAM WILL BE 
REMOVED. NOTAM THAT WOULD PREVIOUSLY BE ISSUED IN THE GOLF SERIES 
WILL BE ISSUED AS EITHER A BRAVO, MIKE, HOTEL OR JULIET SERIES 
DEPENDING ON THE SUBJECT. UK AIC Y104/26 DATED 15 OCT WILL REFER.
NOTAM THAT HAVE AN EFFECTIVE DATE OF 01 JAN 27 OR BEYOND WILL BE 
ISSUED IN THEIR NEW SERIES. GOLF SERIES AFTN ADDRESSES WILL BE 
TRANSFERRED TO THE BRAVO, MIKE, HOTEL OR JULIET SERIES DISTRIBUTION 
LIST.
